facts: No new snow measured at the 3 nearby stations in the 72 hours to Sep 28.

facts.text: Snow left Diamond Lake (5,280 ft) and Summit Lake (5,610 ft) 29 to 38 days earlier this year than the median of the three earlier seasons on file (2023 to 2025).

evidence.name: Diamond Lake
evidence.detail: left April 3; earlier seasons: May 13 (2023), April 18 (2024), May 2 (2025)

evidence.name: Summit Lake
evidence.detail: left May 19; earlier seasons: June 26 (2023), June 23 (2024), June 30 (2025)

facts.text: This year's highest snow water on or after April 1 was the lowest of the four seasons on file (2023 to 2026) at Diamond Lake (5,280 ft) and Summit Lake (5,610 ft).

evidence.name: Diamond Lake
evidence.detail: 0.8 in on April 15; earlier seasons: 20.9 in (2023), 8.1 in (2024), 27.1 in (2025)

evidence.name: Summit Lake
evidence.detail: 12.5 in on April 22; earlier seasons: 47.6 in (2023), 42.0 in (2024), 51.6 in (2025)

facts.text: An estimate: snow left the pass itself between March 16 and May 10, carried from the melt-out dates at Diamond Lake (5,280 ft) and Summit Lake (5,610 ft) to the pass elevation.

evidence.name: Diamond Lake
evidence.detail: melted out April 3, 608 ft above the pass; points to February 25 to April 18

evidence.name: Summit Lake
evidence.detail: melted out May 19, 938 ft above the pass; points to April 4 to May 31
